prompt: 哪一句的過去式才正確？
options: We went to the zoo last Sunday.
We goed to the zoo last Sunday.
We go to the zoo last Sunday.
answer: We went to the zoo last Sunday.

go 是不規則動詞，過去式是 went，不是 goed。
last Sunday 是過去，動詞要用過去式 went。

why: go 的過去式是 went，last Sunday 表示過去。
say: We went to the zoo last Sunday.

options: Did you saw the rainbow?
Did you see the rainbow?
Do you saw the rainbow?

wrong.Did you saw the rainbow?: Did 後面動詞要回到原形 see，不再用過去式。
wrong.Do you saw the rainbow?: saw 是過去式，Do 是現在式助動詞，兩者不能搭配。

why: 疑問句 Did 之後用原形動詞。

options: She did not ate breakfast this morning.
She not eat breakfast this morning.
She did not eat breakfast this morning.
answer: She did not eat breakfast this morning.

did not 後面要用原形 eat，不是過去式 ate。
過去式的否定要用 did not，不能只說 not。

say: She did not eat breakfast this morning.

options: My dad bought a new bike for me.
My dad buyed a new bike for me.
My dad buys a new bike for me yesterday.
answer: My dad bought a new bike for me.

buy 是不規則動詞，過去式是 bought。
yesterday 要搭配過去式，不能用 buys。

say: My dad bought a new bike for me.

prompt: 朋友問你昨天去哪裡玩，你去了河邊並烤了肉。哪一句最自然？
options: I go to the riverside and cooked meat.
I went to the riverside and cooked meat.
I was went to the riverside and cooked meat.
answer: I went to the riverside and cooked meat.

前後動詞時態要一致，昨天的事，go 要變 went。
wrong.I was went to the riverside and cooked m: went 是過去式，前面不能再加 was。

why: 講昨天的事，動詞全部用過去式。
tip: 敘述過去，動詞時態要一致。
say: I went to the riverside and cooked meat.

prompt: 你想問朋友週末有沒有看到一隻漂亮的鳥，哪一句最自然？
options: Do you saw a beautiful bird on the weekend?
Did you saw a beautiful bird on the weekend?
Did you see a beautiful bird on the weekend?
answer: Did you see a beautiful bird on the weekend?

wrong.Do you saw a beautiful bird on the weeke: Do 和 saw 一起用是錯的，過去式的問句要用 Did you see。
wrong.Did you saw a beautiful bird on the week: Did 之後要用原形 see。

why: 問過去的事用 Did 加原形動詞。
say: Did you see a beautiful bird on the weekend?

prompt: 你想說「我昨晚沒有睡好」，哪一句最自然？
options: I did not sleep well last night.
I did not slept well last night.
I not slept well last night.
answer: I did not sleep well last night.

did not 後面要用原形 sleep。
過去式的否定要用 did not。

why: did not 後面要接動詞原形。
tip: 過去否定：did not 加原形。
say: I did not sleep well last night.

text: Yesterday, I _____ a letter to my grandma.
options: write
wrote
writed

wrong.write: Yesterday 是過去，要用過去式，不是原形。
wrong.writed: write 是不規則動詞，過去式是 wrote。

say: Yesterday, I wrote a letter to my grandma.

text: The little boy _____ down the hill and cried.
options: fall
falled
fell

wrong.fall: and cried 是過去式，前面也要用過去式 fell。
wrong.falled: fall 是不規則動詞，過去式是 fell。

say: The little boy fell down the hill and cried.

text: We _____ a big campfire at night and sang songs.
options: made
make
maked

wrong.make: sang 是過去式，這裡也要用過去式 made。
wrong.maked: make 是不規則動詞，過去式是 made。

say: We made a big campfire at night.

text: _____ you take a bus to the city last week?
options: Do
Did
Are

wrong.Do: last week 是過去，問句要用 Did。
wrong.Are: take 是一般動詞，不能用 Are 開頭。

why: last week 是過去，問句用 Did 加原形。
say: Did you take a bus to the city last week?

prompt: 「We explored the old castle together.」是什麼意思？
options: 我們打算去探索古老的城堡。
我們沒有進去那座城堡。
我們一起探索了那座古老的城堡。
answer: 我們一起探索了那座古老的城堡。

wrong.我們打算去探索古老的城堡。: explored 是過去式，表示已經探索過，不是計畫。
wrong.我們沒有進去那座城堡。: explored 是探索過，不是沒去。

why: explored 是 explore 的過去式。
tip: 規則動詞加 ed 變過去式。
say: We explored the old castle together.

prompt: 「It was an unforgettable trip.」是什麼意思？
options: 那是一趟難忘的旅行。
那是一趟很無聊的旅行。
那趟旅行還沒有開始。

wrong.那是一趟很無聊的旅行。: unforgettable 是難以忘記，通常是好的回憶。
wrong.那趟旅行還沒有開始。: was 是過去式，旅行已經結束了。

why: unforgettable 是 forget 加上否定和能力的意思，就是難忘的。

prompt: 「Did you hear the news?」問的是什麼？
options: 你會不會聽新聞？
你有沒有聽到那個消息？
你正在聽新聞嗎？
answer: 你有沒有聽到那個消息？

wrong.你會不會聽新聞？: Did 問的是過去，已經發生的事。
wrong.你正在聽新聞嗎？: 正在做的事會用 Are you listening，Did 問過去。

why: Did you hear 是在問過去有沒有聽到。
